newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: BWT jumps after posting record profits.
newsitem.headline: BWT jumps after posting record profits.

text.p: BWT, the leading manufacturer of water treatment technology in Europe, jumped in an overall limp Vienna market on Tuesday after reporting a record batch of group earnings for 1996.
At 0821 GMT, BWT (Best Water Technology) was up 1.10 percent, or 18 schillings, at 1,650 while the ATX index was a mere 0.06 percent higher.
The shares initially climbed to 1,665 but were knocked down by profit taking as traders said the results were largely in line with market expectations.

Reporting group results, BWT said net profit jumped 27 percent to 168 million schillings, pretax profit climbed 21 percent to 231 million, and planned to hold the dividend steady at 27 schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
